sql: CREATE TABLE runtime_notification_deliveries (id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, user_id BIGINT NOT NULL, payload JSON NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', provider_result JSON NULL, attempts INTEGER UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, next_attempt_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL, lease_token VARCHAR(64) NULL, created_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL, updated_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL, INDEX ix_runtime_notification_due (status,next_attempt_at,id), INDEX ix_runtime_notification_user (user_id,created_at)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
